nodes.title: NewCaseDraftScreen's subject-field tests match the shared component's corrected behavior
nodes.summary: Four stale test assertions in two pre-existing spec files, still asserting the pre-fix "subject permanently disabled/labeled (fixed)" behavior, now match case-version-editor-form-fields.tsx's current, correct behavior (disabled={isBlocked}, labeled "Subject type").

nodes.title: Subject field honors isBlocked like every other declared attribute
nodes.summary: case-version-editor-form-fields.tsx's subject field now disables through isBlocked instead of unconditionally, and its label no longer claims the field is fixed.

nodes.title: NewCaseDraftScreen's subject-field tests match the shared component's corrected behavior
nodes.summary: Independently confirms, against case-version-editor-form-fields.tsx and both corrected spec files as they stand, that all four corrected assertions match the subject Input's current disabled={isBlocked}/"Subject type" behavior and that nothing else in either file changed; adds one new test proving this screen's own isBlocked (createMutation.isPending) is what the four corrected assertions' "false" actually depends on.

nodes.title: Subject field disables through isBlocked, not unconditionally
nodes.summary: Proof that case-version-editor-form-fields.tsx's subject field is enabled on an unblocked draft, disabled for each of isBlocked's four stated reasons, and no longer labeled as fixed.
